cues.en: Hello, my name is Kalman Raitia. I'm going to show you a Lisp machine emulator running on my Acer laptop. This laptop normally boots into Windows, but it's booted into a live DVD that has an Ubuntu Linux system on it with the general software preloaded. And as you can see, we are booted into the emulated Lisp machine. It booted much faster than any real live...
cues.zh: 大家好，我叫 Kalman Raitia。我要给你们演示一个运行在我 Acer 笔记本电脑上的 Lisp 机器模拟器。这台笔记本平时会启动到 Windows，但现在是从一张 Live DVD 启动的，里面是 Ubuntu Linux 系统，预装了常用软件。如你所见，我们已经启动到了模拟的 Lisp 机器里。它启动得比任何真正在运行的...

cues.en: hardware-less machine ever did. I'm going to log in so that I can actually load a file from a real-life hardware-less machine. This is over the network. In fact, this is a file server that's a real-life operating machine at MIT. And I'm going to, this is an editor buffer that's all out like Emacs. We call it CMAX. It's a predecessor to the GNU Emacs, but a successor to the earlier versions of Emacs that were around at the MIT AI lab.
cues.zh: 硬件 Lisp 机器都要快得多。我要登录进去，这样就能真的从一台真实的硬件 Lisp 机器上加载文件。这是通过网络进行的。其实，这是一台在 MIT 真实运行的文件服务器。然后我要——这是一个编辑器缓冲区，像 Emacs 那样显示出来。我们叫它 CMAX。它是 GNU Emacs 的前身，但也是 MIT AI 实验室早期 Emacs 版本的后继者。

cues.zh: 它现在就知道，我输入的开头和结尾部分，唯一能组合成的命令就是 compile buffer。所以现在它可以唯一地补全这条命令，我按回车执行它。于是我又回到 Lisp listener。用现代术语说，这是一个读取-求值-打印循环，但它不寻常的地方在于，不仅允许你输入像 1、2、3 这样的表达式。

This called that, which called this, etc. These are all Lisp functions until we get to here.
cues.zh: 我们确实在执行C代码，通过进入动态监听器进入调试器。注意，我们看到一个栈帧，显示了C函数和C变量。那个小提示符是一个大端序中的小C。这说明我们在一个C函数内部。但是，你知道，这里也有Lisp。这是最顶层的东西。这个调用了那个，那个又调用了这个，等等。这些都是Lisp函数，直到我们到这里。

This is an interface function that I wrote.
cues.zh: 这个读取 JPEG 流的函数，调用 C 系统的 execute 函数来执行一个 C 函数，其中内嵌了一个 Wisp 函数，最终才真正执行 C 函数 read Jafif to imam，它又调用 C 函数 read JPEG file，属于独立 JPEG 组的一部分。这个接口函数是我写的。

cues.en: etc. One of the features of this machine debugger is I can say control x, control xe, which means set trap on exit, and then I can just proceed with our daily special action and go back. Notifications saying that our window was waiting for something to happen. And indeed, what happened is that we got around to the exit from that stack frame.
cues.zh: 等等。这个机器调试器的一个功能是，我可以说 control x、control xe，也就是在退出时设置陷阱，然后继续执行我们日常的特殊操作再返回。通知会显示我们的窗口一直在等待某事发生。而确实发生的是，我们终于执行到了从那个栈帧退出的位置。

cues.en: And I can just continue to exit. A lot of times, you can break into the debugger in any function that's running on Lewis machine. But oftentimes, that might be an in-king in place. Let's say you're holding a lock that the system needs, and so there's a limited amount of stuff you can do. So you can move up the stack frame, say, reenter the debugger when you get to exit this stack frame, and then how you can be outside of the context of that lock and do things. Inside the stack,
cues.zh: 我可以继续退出。很多时候，你可以中断进 Lewis machine 上运行的任意函数调试器中。但通常那可能不是个合适的地方。比如你正持有系统需要的锁，能做的事就很有限。所以你可以往上移动栈帧，比如设置在退出当前栈帧时重新进入调试器，这样就能脱离那个锁的上下文来操作了。在栈内部，

cues.en: in the debugger you can evaluate expressions using the local variable names and values that are current for this particular stack frame. cues.en: And this is a, you know, one of these, try this on your LISP things. LISP machines, Common LISP allows you to have indirect arrays, which point into some other array and share the data. But what they don't allow you to do is to have 2D subsets of 2D arrays. But LISP machine does. So what we're doing here is we're finding the image with the name, and we're sending that object, which is a
cues.zh: 这就是那种“在你的 Lisp 上试试看”的功能。Common Lisp 允许使用间接数组，指向另一个数组并共享数据。但它不允许你取二维数组的二维子集。但 Lisp 机器可以。所以我们这里做的是根据名字找到图像，并向该对象发送消息，它是一个

cues.en: you know, an image object, a data array message which will give us back a raster array, a 2D array. And then we're going to make a new image of type color32bitimage with this name and width and height of just 200 pixels. And its data array, this new image's data array, will be a raster array that's 200 by 200 that has the appropriate type. And it's displaced to the original one, the big one.
cues.zh: 图像对象，发送一个 data array 消息，它会返回给我们一个光栅数组，也就是二维数组。然后我们创建一个类型为 color32bitimage 的新图像，指定这个名字，宽高都只有 200 像素。而这个新图像的数据数组，会是一个对应类型的 200x200 光栅数组。并且它是映射到原本那个大数组上的。

cues.en: However, it's displaced conformally. That means that not only do we displace to a starting point, but we displace in such a way that the stride comes out correctly so that it actually is a 2D subset. And then, of course, we have to say how far in we're displacing. And so we're basically getting what would be the index of the 300 by 560 point as the starting point of our displacement. So let me run this. And notice I get back an image.
cues.zh: 不过，它是按共形方式位移的。这意味着我们不仅位移到一个起始点，而且位移的方式要让步幅正确输出，从而它实际上是一个二维子集。然后，当然，我们还得说明向内位移了多远。所以我们基本上是把300乘560那个点的索引作为位移的起始点。那么让我运行这个。注意我拿回了一张图像。
